package.name: niryo_safety
package.description: Runtime safety supervision for the Niryo Ned2 planning stack. Watches the action currently dispatched by PlanSys2 and polls the world model for the invariant that action depends on (path clearance for move, node clearance for pick and place), raising an alert when it is violated. The monitor is a sensor: it never commands the arm, the action performer owns the motion goal.
